name: Dondozo
description: Dondozo, the Big Catfish Pokémon. A Water type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
